sloka: स सर्वान् सान्त्वयामास नैर्ऋतान्नैर्ऋतर्षभः ।बोधनाद् विस्मितश्चापि राक्षसानिदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.६०.६७ ।।।।
transliteration: sa sarvān sāntvayāmāsa nairṛtānnairṛtarṣabhaḥ ।bodhanād vismitaścāpi rākṣasānidamabravīt ।। 6.60.67 ।।।।

translations.english: "Is there any fear of some enemies Is it because of that you have woken me up Let me know."
